changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Flash: Added a damage amplification effect when Devastating Tornado, Blazing Tornado, or Icebound Tornado hits. Damage increases by 12% for 3 seconds per hit, stacking up to 99 times. Attacks from behind apply 3 stacks.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Rear Strike: Added an effect granting All Species Bonus Damage +200 for 3s.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Gravity: Fixed an issue where Tevent's Despair Trap and Enraged Tevent's Despair Trap were not activating with Collision: Pull effects from the Gravity Skill Core.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Death Blow Specialization 1 [Charge Damage]: Reduced the time required to reach maximum charge by 25%.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Guillotine Blade: Expanded the damage amplification conditions to apply against targets affected by any Collision effect instead of just Collision: Prone.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Guillotine Blade Specialization 1 [Charge Damage]: Reduced the time required to reach maximum charge by 25%.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.skill_or_mechanic_name: Weapon Mastery Defense Achievement Effect [Steel Sacrifice]
changes.change_text: Weapon Mastery Defense Achievement Effect [Steel Sacrifice]: Fixed an issue where the tooltip did not display the 'Ranged and Magic Heavy Attack Chance -100' portion of the effect.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Roar of Rage: Fixed an issue where Spectrum of Agony was not activating against targets affected by Weaken: Provoke applied by Roar of Rage.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Common Support Achievement Effect [Gerard's Resilience]: Updated the tooltip to correctly indicate that the effect activates when evading, blocking, or blocking with a Defense skill.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Strafing: Corrected damage values displayed at higher growth stages. Note that this is just a text update, effective damage values remain unchanged.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Flash Arrow Specialization 1 [Flash Wave]: Corrected the tooltip to indicate that the effect only applies to party members, not allies.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Eye of Ventius: Reduced monster damage amplification from 50% to 20%.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Will of Fonsiné: Changed the PvP damage reduction effect to apply globally, rather than only on specific skills.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Blade Storm: Fixed an issue where damage and Weaken effects could bypass Defense skills.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Elemental Awakening: Reduced the activation requirements for Fire from 5 to 3 and Lightning from 7 to 4. Ice activation requirements remain unchanged.
sub_lines: Slightly reduced the remaining cooldown reduction granted at all growth stages to account for the lower activation requirements.
At Heroic Lv. 5, cooldown percentage has decreased from 17.5% to 15%.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.skill_or_mechanic_name: Skill Core: Thunder's Shadow, Lightning Condensation, Thunderclouds Explosion
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Thunder's Shadow, Lightning Condensation, Thunderclouds Explosion: Added damage amplification information to the skill descriptions.
sub_lines: When multiple Skill Core effects are active simultaneously, only the highest damage amplification effect is applied.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Thunder's Shadow: Fixed an issue causing Thunder's Shadow to occasionally not hit other players in PvP.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Skill Core: Nightmare Melody: Fixed an issue causing the damage over time effect from Corrupted Magic Circle [Decaying Touch] to get removed when Nightmare Melody was applied to a target at the same time.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Abyssal Cleave Specialization 3 [Critical Cleave]: Fixed an issue where the buff icon remained after the effect expired.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Star Destroyer Specialization 4 [Additional Effect]: Changed the healing reduction effect from a guaranteed 80% healing reduction to an 80% chance to apply an 80% healing reduction for 3 seconds.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Consecutive Claws: Added tooltip text indicating Bleeding can stack up to 10 times.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Critical Hit / Short Jab: Critical Hit has been renamed to Short Jab.
sub_lines: Changed so the skill can now be used while moving.
Fixed an issue where the skill shared a cooldown with Orb's Void Slash.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Sweep: Fixed an issue where the target's Collision Resistance was ignored.
sub_lines: Fixed an issue that incorrectly increased the caster's CC Resistance.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Explosive Flurry: Fixed an issue allowing continuous activation of Queen Bellandir's Gravity Field and Enraged Queen Bellandir's Gravity Field under certain conditions.

changes.section: Balance Adjustments and Skill Bug Fixes
changes.change_text: Uncommon Attack Achievement Effect [Threat Suppression]: Corrected the tooltip to reflect that Base Damage increases up to 3.25% based on growth stage.
